data.short_meaning: Man of God, Friend of God
data.long_meaning: Rahul means 'friend' and Dev means 'God'. So, the name Rahuldev means 'Man of God' or 'Friend of God'. The name Rahuldev carries the meaning “Man of God, Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rahuldev usually hope their child will grow to embody man of god, friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Rahuldev belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man of God, Friend of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahuldev total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
